purpose: Record bounded field-level source-context extraction for the eighth C2 long-tail batch covering pain, trauma recovery, neurodevelopment, sensory communication, autonomic regulation, BCI governance and living neural computation domains while keeping local review, independent fresh review, reviewed artifacts and model admission blocked.

currentLimitations: This register records local field extraction only; it does not complete local source-context review or independent fresh review.
PubMed abstract routes, practice-portal pages, policy instruments and guideline pages may still require manual/fulltext or route-specific context review before artifact promotion.

Living neural computation and organoid intelligence rows are explicitly bounded as research-domain context, not evidence for network effects, scalable intelligence, consciousness or human-surpassing capability.
No row may be used for clinical advice, neurotechnology advice, biocomputing capability claims, calibrated prediction, individual death-date output, intervention ranking or domain-claim upgrade.

sourceAccessNotes: Candidate URLs were inherited from the C2-LT-B8 promotion queue sourceCheck records created on 2026-07-03; this register does not perform independent fresh review.
PubMed routes are treated as bibliographic/abstract routes pending full source-context review when the exact guideline/article text is needed.
Official CDC, WHO, VA, ASHA, NIDCD, NEI, OECD and Frontiers routes remain bounded to their page/report/policy/article roles until local review confirms extractable claim scope.
Synthetic biological intelligence rows must remain blocked for network-effect, consciousness, sentience, deployable-computing or human-surpassing intelligence claims.

extractedRows.sourceTitle: CDC Clinical Practice Guideline for Prescribing Opioids for Pain — United States, 2022
extractedRows.exactClaimUse: Can support bounded framing that pain management requires explicit risk-benefit review, functional goals, nonopioid and opioid safety boundaries, follow-up and harm-mitigation rather than a simple analgesic-maximization target.
extractedRows.endpointDefinition: Candidate endpoints include pain interference, pain intensity, functional restoration, opioid exposure, adverse events, overdose or misuse risk, sleep disruption and follow-up continuity.
extractedRows.populationOrSetting: Adults with acute, subacute or chronic pain in outpatient care contexts covered by the CDC opioid prescribing guideline; not cancer pain, palliative care or end-of-life care as a generalized rule.
extractedRows.effectOrMechanismSignal: Mechanism signal is risk-governed treatment: unmanaged pain consumes attention and action capacity, while poorly bounded opioid treatment can add overdose, dependence, sedation and care-fragmentation risks.
extractedRows.uncertaintyOrBias: Guideline recommendations are not individual treatment instructions; evidence certainty varies by condition, opioid history, comorbidity, access to nonopioid care and local implementation.
extractedRows.transferBoundary: Transfer only to pain domain endpoint design, analgesic-risk boundary and care-continuity framing; do not use to rank treatments or infer individual benefit, harm or lifespan effects.
